evidence: A single cycle of a typical deposition process consisted of: TMP plasma / pumping / O 2 plasma / pumping / DEZn exposure / pumping. All precursors were introduced into the chamber while it was continuously pumped, reaching a partial pressure of 5×1 0 − 3 mbar in the deposition chamber. In between precursor pulses, pumping times of 20 s were found sufficient to bring residual pressures to below 4 × 10 − 5 mbar, thereby avoiding CVD side reactions.
